C1 commentary · 233 words
## bhair-p01-v01 — C1 **SUMMARY.** Oṃ to Consciousness-Bhairava; shelter-takers take knowing, wander never vain; grace-bent Śiva conquers. Bhairava alone supreme nectar-one ablaze; sense-ring-swallowed all; venerated. Praised-praiser-praise though distinct undiffering; whatever formed by knowing becomes this, enduring. All melted, bliss-massed; Your principle's likeness in Your shape venerated. Letter-script outlines man; shape reveals varied-formed You, supreme self. Concept-free entered; we reflect what fancy never catches. Made, worded, offered: guru unfolded then heart entered. Mirroring praise of own-massed self; bonds outpoured in body-temple. Named powers conquer; splits gained, mouths skull-called. Objected limbs Yours to Sadāśiva; corpse-self Your seat. *Rasa: maṅgala-bhakti of salute; bhakti-vīra of praised alone; adbhuta of undiffering three; bhakti-adbhuta of likeness venerated; adbhuta of revealed shape; vīra of concept-free reflecting; bhakti of arranged offerings; bhakti-vīra of temple praise; vīra of conquering powers; adbhuta of corpse-seat — The sthāyibhāva is love-address: salute, shelter, conquer. Invoking relished. The sthāyibhāva is devotion-exultation: alone, nectar, ablaze, venerated. Praising relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: three named, none apart. Undifference relished. The sthāyibhāva is devotion-wonder: melted, massed, likened, venerated. Likeness relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: outlined, massed, revealed. Revealing relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: entered concept-free, reflected true. Reflecting relished. The sthāyibhāva is devotion: made, worded, laid, entered. Offering relished. The sthāyibhāva is devotion-exultation: praised mirroring, bonds poured, temple named. Praising relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: named, conquering, called. Conquering relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: limbed, Sadāśiva'd, corpse-seated. Seating relished.*

C1 commentary · 225 words
## bhair-p02-v11 — C1 **SUMMARY.** Light-bodied thought-power supreme goddess; hers the spreading of all. Bearing shown; world-opposed in me true-formed unopposed. Thread dissolved, sapless crowd; garland shown as-if to us. Look doubled at expelled nooses; gut-holding as-if appears speaking. Passionate cloth cast in highest heaven; bloodied hide head-borne told. Bared splitting by sword; world-taken heroes best. Fear-slayer lorded standing; shield-clash pointing us. Self-noosed, knowing-bodied, I count time; noose-held shown death's death. Difference-made hurled to unmake by own power; goad-held plain by supreme Bhairava. Bow-shown, lords arrayed; cause-deer pierced deer-like by power. *Rasa: adbhuta of spreading goddess; vīra of unopposed-in-me; adbhuta of as-if showing; vīra of commanded seeing; adbhuta of cast cloth; vīra of best heroes; abhaya-vīra of fear-not; vīra of counted time; vīra of hurled distinction; vīra of deer-pierced cause — The sthāyibhāva is wonder: bodied, spread, led. Spreading relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: borne, opposed, unopposed. Pointing relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: dissolved, garlanded, as-if. Showing relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: commanded twice, appeared. Commanding relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: cloth cast, hide told. Casting relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: bared, splitting, best. Baring relished. The sthāyibhāva is fearless exultation: slayer standing, shield shown. Fearlessness relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: noosed, counted, shown. Counting relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: hurled, goaded, plain. Hurling relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: shown bow, pierced deer. Piercing relished.*

## bhair-p04-v31 — C1 **SUMMARY.** Power-egg-middled saps all drunk always; within shown as-if. Pride-bond uprooters crested embodied lotus-shown, held. Seed-ground first mirrored waking-treasure; pomegranate show-played. Though Bhairava-shaped, rosary-held turns world within by letters. Bone-skull-ash-blood decked teaches world pure by Brahma-fullness. Self-pleased adverse bubbles; desire-burning brow-eye supreme-fire taught. Inward-aimed expanding shows unstained self in every state. Sky-cladness speaks self bare; how should Māyā's veil cover suns? All-destroyer shown from darkness-ground, gleaming-bodied. Brahma-full wearing Bhairava-form shown; differing yet freed. *Rasa: pāna-vīra of drunk world-saps; vīra of held lotuses; vīra of mirrored seed; vīra of letter-turned world; raudra-vīra of gore-taught pure; raudra of brow-eye burning; vīra of aimed inward; adbhuta of bare-speaking sky; adbhuta of dark-shown destroyer; vīra-śānta of parted-freed — The sthāyibhāva is exultation: middled, drunk, within. Drinking relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: uprooted, lotus-shown, held. Holding relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: seeded, mirrored, played. Mirroring relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: shaped, held, turned. Turning relished. The sthāyibhāva is fierce exultation: decked gore, taught pure. Teaching relished. The sthāyibhāva is fierceness: jarred bubbles, burning brow. Burning relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: aimed, expanding, unstained. Aiming relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: bare spoken, veil questioned. Questioning relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: dark ground, gleaming shown. Showing relished. The sthāyibhāva is peaceful exultation: worn, shown, freed. Freeing relished.*
